title: NTA UGC NET June 2020 E Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in
2. e-Certificate section for previous sessions
3. Enter June 2020 application details
4. Download certificate if available
5. Alternatively retrieve from DigiLocker
shortDescription: NTA UGC NET June 2020 E-Certificate – download historical NET certificate from NTA / DigiLocker.
content: Qualified candidates of UGC NET June 2020 can download e-certificates from the NTA UGC NET portal (if archive is active) or from DigiLocker linked accounts.
